title: A tour of the window
summary: The parts of the editor's window, in about two minutes.

steps.title: A tour of the window
steps.text: Twelve steps, about two minutes. Back and Next go through them; Escape ends the tour, and Help, Tours starts it again.

steps.title: The modes
steps.text: Each mode is one kind of work: the map's settings, the shape of the terrain, its paint and masks, water, lighting, markers, props, decals, units and sketches. F1 to F12 choose them; Procedural and Plugins sit at the bottom.

steps.title: The mode's panel
steps.text: What the mode has: its tools first, then what it works on, the height layers here. Choose an entry to edit it in the inspector.

steps.title: The tool's settings
steps.text: The active tool's settings in one row, the most used first. What does not fit the window lies behind More.

guide.more: Brush settings are kept per tool. The keys [ and ] make a brush smaller and larger.

steps.title: What the views show
steps.text: Top, 3D or both side by side, the map's symmetry, and a chip for each overlay: markers, path nodes, the 3D camera, and more behind More.

steps.title: The top view
steps.text: The map from above. The left mouse uses the tool, the right or middle mouse moves the map, the wheel zooms.

steps.title: Try it: the 3D view
steps.done: That is the 3D view. The wheel zooms towards the mouse, the middle mouse moves, space and the mouse turn the view. Both views share the camera.

steps.title: The dock
steps.text: The problems the checks found, the history of undo steps, the workspace's assets to drag onto the map, and the Console.

steps.title: The inspector
steps.text: Edits what you chose last: an entry of the panel, things on the map, or an asset on the shelf.

steps.title: The status bar
steps.text: What the last operation did, the mode and tool, what is out of date, and the switch that makes results again on their own.

steps.title: Every operation is a command
steps.text: Ctrl+K finds any of them by name, with its shortcut. The menus hold the same commands.

steps.title: That is the window
steps.text: Help, Tours starts this tour again and lists the others.
